Gujarat 
Panchayats 
Act, 1993.
NOTIFICATION
Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department,
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar.
Dated the ..............., 2025. 
N o . KP/13 OF 2025/PRHRDD/mis/e-file/14/2022/1451/Section-J:-WHEREAS certain
draft rules were published as required by sub-section (5) of section 274 of the Gujarat
Panchayats Act 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993) at pages 92 to 93 in the Gujarat Government
Gazette, PART I-A, Central Section, dated the 26th December, 2024, under the
Government Notiﬁcation, Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department,
No. KP/59 OF 2024/PRHRDD/mis/e-file/14/2022/1451/Section-J, dated the 9th December,
2024 inviting objections and suggestions from all persons likely to be aﬀected thereby
within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of the said notiﬁcation in the
Official Gazette; 
AND WHEREAS no objection or suggestion has been received by the Government in
respect of the said draft notification; 
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 274
read with sections 116,119,120,138,141,142,163,166,167 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act
1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby makes the following rules
further to amend the Gujarat Panchayats Financial Accounts and Budget Rules, 2014,
namely:- 
1. (1) These rules may be called the Gujarat Panchayats Financial Accounts and Budget
(Amendment) Rules, 2025.
(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. In the Gujarat Panchayats Financial Accounts and Budget Rules, 2014 (hereinafter
referred to as "the said rules"), for rule 10, the following rule shall be substituted, namely:-
“10. (1) Any amount received as and when in Panchayat Oﬃce, a receipt in the format of
Form No. 2, generated (Printed) through "Gram Suvidha Portal” in duplicate, shall be
issued to the party concerned in original, while duplicate (oﬃce) copy of the same shall be
kept in the office for record.
       In case of any amount received directly in the bank account of village panchayat by
electronic mode, a system generated receipt along with auto generated unique transaction
identification number shall be issued to the party concerned through electronic mode.
(2) The amount shall be shown on credit side in the petty cash book to be maintained in
Panchayat Account in Form No. 43 from the duplicate (oﬃce) copy of the receipt and also
unique transaction identiﬁcation number generated upon any amount received
electronically directly in the bank account of village panchayat. While signing the entries in
petty cash book, the oﬃcer concerned shall ensure that no entries of receipts (both the
modes mentioned in sub rule - (1)) are left out".
3. In the said rules, for rule 27, the following rule shall be substituted, namely:- 
Letter No: PRHRDD/0086/03/2025   Approved Date: 27-03-2025
File No: PRHRDD/mis/e-file/14/2022/1451/Section - J
Approved By: Secretary,PRHRDD
1/2

"27. Payment shall be ordinarily be made by e-payment, but claims below Rs.500/-
(rupees ﬁve hundred only) may be paid from the permanent advance or imprest. Such
expenditure shall be made in accordance with the prevailing provisions of Mumbai
Contingency Expenditure Rules, 1959. Except in the case of claims by Government, no e-
payment shall be made for claims below Rs. 500/-(rupees ﬁve hundred only). Payment
through cheque/RTGS/NEFT etc. can be made only after obtaining prior permission from
the office of Development Commissioner".
4. In the said rules, for rule 28, the following rule shall be substituted, namely:-
"28. As the Panchayat Fund is also deposited in a Government Treasury, sums due to
Government shall be paid by e-payment/Cheque drawn on the Treasury".
